Syntax
Std_ReturnType E2E_P08mForward (
const E2E_P08mConfigType* ConfigPtr,
uint32 Length,
E2E_PCheckStatusType ForwardStatus,
E2E_P08mProtectStateType* StatePtr,
uint32 SourceID,
Std_MessageTypeType MessageType,
Std_MessageResultType Messageresult,
uint8* DataPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x62
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant

Pointer to static configuration.

reconstruct on output data.
